entries.en: Under the great serpent's auspices, we've been able to treat a range of common diseases. However, prevention is worth a ponze of cure, and so I mean to do all within my power to ensure our workers are in tip-top shape.
entries.fr: Serpent marin de Ronka avoir souvent aidé Qitari à se soigner, mais si Qitari mal se nourrir et pas assez se reposer, continuuuer à tomber malade tout le temps<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
水蛇様のお導きにより、此度は病を治めることができました～。
……でありまするが、日頃からきちんと栄養を摂取し、
病に負けぬ身体を作ることが、肝要なのでございましょ～！

entries.en: Our workers venture daily into the unknown and risk life and limb in the pursuit of our shared history. Needless to say, it is of the utmost importance that they remain hale and hearty. After all, we won't make much progress if our workers are dropping like flies!
entries.fr: Troupes d'explorateurs avoir déjà pain sur planche, alors devoir maintenir condition physique en béton armé en toutes cir<->cons<->tan<->ces<nbsp>! Très très important pour avenir des Qitari<nbsp>!

丈夫な身体を作ることが、肝要なのでございましょ～！

entries.en: Ah, I feel reinvigorated just by looking at such a splendid specimen! Whatever it is I end up cooking out of this, I aim to make it the talk of the camp!

ご協力に感謝いたしまする～！
